description_en: Submits an asynchronous video text erasure task that supports full-video erasure, time range-based erasure, and region-specific erasure
description_zh: 提交异步视频文字擦除任务，支持整段擦除、时间范围和指定区域
name: SubmitVideoDetextJob

parameters.help_en: The input configuration JSON string. You must specify either VideoUrl or VideoMediaId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 输入配置 JSON 字符串。VideoUrl 与 VideoMediaId 必须且只能提供一个
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The output configuration JSON string. OssUri specifies an OSS directory or MP4 file path and cannot contain query parameters or fragments. For directory paths, detext.mp4 is automatically appended. Paths ending with .mp4 without a trailing / are used directly as the target file. If not specified, a signed URL of the processing result is returned in the query result
parameters.help_zh: 输出配置 JSON 字符串。OssUri 可指定 OSS 目录或 MP4 文件路径，不能包含 Query 参数或 Fragment；目录自动追加 detext.mp4，以 .mp4 结尾且无末尾 / 时直接作为目标文件。未指定时在查询结果中返回处理结果的签名 URL
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The text erasure parameter JSON string. This string can contain EraseAllText, TimeRanges, TextTargets, FullEraseTargets, and Config
parameters.help_zh: 文字擦除参数 JSON 字符串，可包含 EraseAllText、TimeRanges、TextTargets、FullEraseTargets 和 Config
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The custom data JSON string for pass-through in desired state notifications. For MNS callbacks, use NotifyAddress to specify a queue name prefixed with yike-callback, and use NotifyMnsEndpoint to specify an MNS endpoint under the same account. For HTTP(S) callbacks, use NotifyAddress to specify the full URL
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据 JSON 字符串，用于终态通知透传。MNS 回调使用 NotifyAddress 指定以 yike-callback 为前缀的队列名称，使用 NotifyMnsEndpoint 指定同账号的 MNS 接入点；HTTP(S) 回调使用 NotifyAddress 指定完整地址
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The user-level idempotency token. Maximum length: 40 characters. If the same user submits a request with the same token, the original task is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用户维度的幂等令牌，最长 40 个字符。相同用户使用同一令牌重复提交时返回原任务
parameters.name: client_token

JobId.description_en: The video text erasure job ID. Use this ID to call GetVideoDetextJob to query the job
JobId.description_zh: 视频文字擦除任务 ID，用于调用 GetVideoDetextJob 查询任务
JobId.title_en: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID
JobId.title_zh: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查
